messages.subject: plot.trajectory node size & text formatting
messages.body_plain:
Is there a relatively straightforward way, perhaps with some additional arguments, to have plot.trajectory()
1. Adjust elements so that text does not extend past the node boundaries (e.g., shrinking text font size and/or expanding node size)?
2. Plot the entire text of log messages rather than cutting the text off with ellipses after 10 characters?

Thank you!
